description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to flow control, including FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration, with associated constants, types, and metadata annotations.

classes.name: FlowSchema
classes.description: Represents a schema for grouping API requests with similar attributes, including metadata, spec, and status.

classes.name: FlowSchemaSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired configuration of a FlowSchema, including priority, rules, and distinguisher method.

classes.name: FlowSchemaStatus
classes.description: Current status of a FlowSchema, including conditions.

classes.name: FlowSchemaCondition
classes.description: Describes a specific condition of a FlowSchema, including type, status, reason, and message.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfiguration
classes.description: Defines configuration for a request priority level, including metadata, spec, and status.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfigurationSpec
classes.description: Specifies whether the priority level is exempt or limited, and associated configurations.

classes.name: LimitedPriorityLevelConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for handling requests under limits, including concurrency shares and limit response.

classes.name: ExemptPriorityLevelConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for exempt priority levels, including nominal concurrency shares and lendable percent.

classes.name: LimitResponse
classes.description: Defines how to handle requests that cannot be immediately executed, either queue or reject.

classes.name: QueuingConfiguration
classes.description: Parameters for request queuing, including number of queues, shuffle hand size, and queue length limit.

classes.name: PriorityLevelConfigurationCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition of a PriorityLevelConfiguration, including type, status, reason, and message.

classes.name: FlowDistinguisherMethod
classes.description: Defines how to compute flow distinguishers for requests matching a schema.
